changelog:
Initial release of Ra Lite – Research Intelligence.

- Instantly generates a structured, 3-source research brief on any topic using web search.
- Requires a RESEARCH_TOPIC environment variable for flexible input.
- Step-by-step setup and usage guide included.
- Produced output features executive summary, key findings with citations, and concise source descriptions.
- Highlights differences between Lite, Standard, and Pro tiers, with upgrade information.
summary: Ra Lite -- Research Intelligence. Drop a topic and get an instant structured 3-source research brief. Free tier of Ra.
